year_display.zh: 周代，约公元前 600 年以前

edition.en: The received Mao text as given on Chinese Wikisource, without the Mao preface, chapter count and notes. Lines broken at the punctuation for reading; text unchanged.
edition.zh: 据维基文库所载毛诗本，删去《毛诗序》、章句说明与注解。按标点分行，文字未改。

basis.en: A song from the Book of Songs (Shijing), compiled by about the sixth century BCE.
basis.zh: 《诗经》中的诗篇，约于公元前六世纪编定。

note.en: A soldiers' song from the Lesser Odes of the Book of Songs, sung on the way home from a long frontier posting. For five stanzas it is all hunger, harness and duty; then the last stanza turns, and 'when I set out, the willows swayed; now I return, the snow is falling' became one of the most quoted lines in the language for how time passes while you are away. Notice the ferns: sprouting, tender, tough, a whole season measured by what the soldiers ate.
note.zh: 《诗经·小雅》里的一首戍卒之歌，唱在久戍归来的路上。前五章写饥渴、车马和差事；末章一转，“昔我往矣，杨柳依依；今我来思，雨雪霏霏”，成了汉语里写离家之后时间流逝最常被引用的句子。留意那些薇菜：从“作”到“柔”再到“刚”，一整季的光阴，是用他们吃的野菜来量的。

excerpt.orig: 昔我往矣，楊柳依依。今我來思，雨雪霏霏。
excerpt.en: When I set out long ago, / the willows were soft and swaying. / Now, as I come back, / the snow is falling thick.
excerpt.zh: 昔我往矣，杨柳依依。今我来思，雨雪霏霏。

gloss.en: 薇 is wild vetch, a pea-like plant with edible young shoots; the soldiers forage for it.
gloss.zh: 薇：野豌豆一类的植物，嫩苗可食。戍卒采它充饥。

gloss.en: 作: sprouting. 止, which closes many lines in this song, is a particle with no meaning of its own.
gloss.zh: 作：冒出地面。止：句末语气词，无实义。

gloss.en: The Xianyun, a nomadic people on the Zhou's northern frontier, usually identified with the later Xiongnu.
gloss.zh: 猃狁（xiǎn yǔn）：西周时北方的游牧部族，一般认为即后来的匈奴。

gloss.en: 陽 is the tenth month of the old calendar, the beginning of winter.
Bow-ends tipped with ivory, and quivers made from the hide of a sea creature, traditionally glossed as seal or shark.
gloss.zh: 象弭：两端用象牙装饰的弓。鱼服：用鱼兽皮（一说鲨鱼皮）制成的箭袋。

gloss.en: 雨 is a verb here, to fall (read yù): snow falling, thick and fast.
gloss.zh: 雨（yù）：动词，落下。霏霏：雪下得很密的样子。
